codes.CONTRACT_VALIDATION_FAILED: Request violates a known operation or resource contract.
codes.NO_BACKEND_COMPLETED: No permitted backend completed the operation.
codes.NONFINITE_OUTPUT_REJECTED: A deterministic local backend produced NaN or infinity and the contract rejected it.
codes.WORKER_BOUNDARY_FAILURE: The Python worker boundary could not decode, validate, or execute the request.
codes.CONTROL_PLANE_BOUNDARY_FAILURE: The JavaScript CLI/control boundary could not process the request.
codes.INTERVAL_DOMAIN_REJECTED: Interval request violates enclosure-domain requirements such as a divisor containing zero.
codes.CONTRACTED_LOCAL_EXECUTION_FAILED: A known contracted operation was attempted by deterministic local backends and failed; external web/LLM fallback is intentionally blocked.
